components.name: Primary Order Button
components.description: Cobalt action for the hero and prominent order routes.
components.css: .ds-order-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 52px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; padding: 0 22px; background: #0757d5; color: #fff; border-radius: 2px; font: 800 13px 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-order-primary:hover { background: #0642ac; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-order-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #141512; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Red Order Button
components.description: Red order action used in the header and contact section.
components.css: .ds-order-red { display: inline-flex; min-height: 51px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 13px; padding: 0 22px; background: #c91d17; color: #fff; border-radius: 2px; font: 800 12px 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-order-red:hover { background: #a91813; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-order-red:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #141512; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Menu Navigation
components.description: Direct links with a simple underline state.
components.css: .ds-main-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 22px; } .ds-main-nav a { padding: 8px 0; color: #0642ac; font: 700 13px 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-main-nav a:hover, .ds-main-nav a:focus-visible { border-bottom-color: #c91d17; } .ds-main-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #141512; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Featured Tray Tile
components.description: Rectangular, image-led food tile with a cobalt copy panel.
components.html:
SAUCE BLANCHE

Rice, crispy chicken, house sauce.
components.css: .ds-tray-tile { overflow: hidden; background: #0757d5; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 17px 36px rgb(31 34 31 / 11%); } .ds-tray-tile img { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1.35; object-fit: cover; } .ds-tray-tile div { padding: 20px 24px; } .ds-tray-tile h3 { margin: 0; font: 800 30px/.98 'Barlow Condensed', Impact, sans-serif; } .ds-tray-tile p { margin: 10px 0 0; font: 500 14px/1.6 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Student Offer Teaser
components.description: Compact paper callout linking to current student offer details.
components.html: ✳ÉTUDIANT·E ? Des offres sont disponibles ! ↗
components.css: .ds-student-teaser { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid #d9d2bd; border-top: 2px solid #c91d17; background: #fffdf5; color: #141512; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgb(17 25 37 / 7%); font: 600 11px/1.45 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-student-teaser > span:first-child { display: grid; width: 28px; height: 28px; place-items: center; background: #0757d5; color: white; font-size: 16px; } .ds-student-teaser b { font-weight: 800; } .ds-student-teaser:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #141512; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-menu-prices { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin-top: 13px; } .ds-menu-prices > div { display: grid; gap: 3px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-menu-prices strong { font: 900 26px/1 'Barlow Condensed', Impact, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-menu-prices span { font: 800 8px/1.2 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .055em; }

narrative.overview: A casual local restaurant site built around the Crousty Chicken identity, rectangular tray imagery, and clear menu, location, and order routes. Cream and cobalt carry the page while red and yellow punctuate choices. The design avoids generic fast-food templates and keeps mobile copy separate from busy photography.
keyCharacteristics: Cobalt-and-cream fields with red and yellow accents
Condensed display headlines paired with DM Sans reading text
Rectangular food trays and straightforward ordering actions
Mobile hero text above the photo for clear reading

rules.name: The Clear Copy Rule
rules.body: Keep body text on a solid, high-contrast surface; do not place paragraphs or actions over busy food photography.

rules.name: The Small Lift Rule
rules.body: Use shadows only where a control or food panel needs separation; the page itself stays flat.

dos: Do keep menu, directions, phone, and order links easy to find on small screens.
Do use the restaurant's real logo and rectangular tray imagery.
Do keep text and controls on a solid surface with clear contrast.
Do preserve the friendly local tone and only publish confirmed menu and offer details.
donts: Don't use a generic fast-food template or copy that could describe any restaurant.
Don't layer mobile hero text or buttons over busy food photography.
Don't make up prices, opening hours, ingredients, allergens, or student-offer conditions.
Don't blur online prices with the identical in-store price used across Crousty recipes.
Don't turn rectangular tray imagery into generic round-bowl product art.
